Mars Ore can be obtained in Exploration Sites on the Continent Map. The ore is required to produce Goods in your Mars Colony.
Superalloys are a Space Age Mars good.
Bio Tech Crops are a Space Age Mars good.
Lubricants are a Space Age Mars good.
Mars Microbes are a Space Age Mars good.
Fusion Reactors are a Space Age Mars good.

Use Trade Coins to purchase items in the Antiques Dealer’s shop. You can also use to Trade Coins to bid for auction items. You can obtain additional Trade Coins by exchanging items at the Antiques Dealer.
Use Gemstones to purchase rare items in the Antiques Dealer’s shop. You can obtain additional Gemstones by exchanging rare items at the Antiques Dealer.
Tickets can be collected from quests and incidents or can be purchased. Use them at the wheel of fortune in Halloween Event.
Earn Bat Tokens by throwing knives at the Joker’s Wheel and completing daily tasks. Use them at the Clown’s Counter to trade for spooky seasonal rewards.
Earn rare Cat Charms exclusively from the Joker’s Wheel. Each one grants bonus Grand Prize points and can be exchanged at the Clown’s Counter for exclusive prizes.
Pots of Gold can be collected from quests and incidents or for purchase! Use them to hire and upgrade building managers or on special actions like Time Skip to gain Shamrocks!

Use Moves to make pops on the board inside levels in the Wildlife Event!
Use Entrance Tickets to enter the park and play a level in the Wildlife Event!
Use Wildlife Coins to purchase more Moves and powerful boosters for levels in the Wildlife Event!
Choose a block on the board to destroy it! Can only be used on blocks! Boosters are global and not bound to a level.
Choose a block to destroy all other blocks of the same color from the board! Can only be used on blocks! Boosters are global and not bound to a level.
Removes all blocks from a row! Can only be used on blocks. Boosters are global and not bound to level.

Unknown DNA can be obtained in Exploration Sites on the Continent Map. The DNA is required to produce Goods in your Jupiter Moon Colony.
Red Algae are a Space Age Jupiter Moon good.
Bio Creatures are a Space Age Jupiter Moon good.
Topological Records are a Space Age Jupiter Moon good.
Enhanced Porifera is a Space Age Jupiter Moon good.
Advanced DNA Data are a Space Age Jupiter Moon good.
Energy can be collected from quests and incidents or can be purchased. Use it to spawn new pieces on the board, to reset your board or to reroll tasks.
Spawn pieces without spending any Energy.
Break down a higher-level piece into two lower-level pieces. Any keys or key parts on the higher-level piece will be retained on both lower-level pieces.
Converts all pieces of one color on the board to colorless pieces. Colorless pieces can be merged with any color.
Doubloons can be collected from quests and incidents or can be purchased. Use it to open new rewards on the board.
Collect 4 Turquoise Key Parts to open a door you missed in the Summer Event's Calendar!
Crystallized Hydrocarbons can be obtained in Exploration Sites on the Continent Map. The Hydrocarbons are required to produce Goods in your Titan Colony.
Compressed Matter Capsule is a Space Age Titan good.
Isolated Molecules are a Space Age Titan good.
Experimental Data is a Space Age Titan good.
Liquid Binder is a Space Age Titan good.
Upcycled Hydrocarbons are a Space Age Titan good.
Gemstones can be collected from quests and incidents or can be purchased. Use them to hire Overseers or special actions like Time Skips to gain Feast Provisions.
Defender Badges can be collected from sending defenders with fully merged badges into cooldown or from daily challenges. Use them to open valuable training bags!
Attacker Badges can be collected from sending attackers with fully merged badges into cooldown or from daily challenges. Use them to open valuable training bags!
Midfielder Badges can be collected from sending midfielders with fully merged badges into cooldown or from daily challenges. Use them to open valuable training bags!
Footballs can be collected from quests and incidents or can be purchased. Use them to warm-up new players on the field or to reset your field without a field completion reward.
Use Moves to make pops on the board inside levels in the Fall Event!
Use Wooden Spoons in the Fall Event's culinary traditions and play a level!
When activated, the Golden Spoon eliminates the need for Wooden Spoons to play a level. The Golden Spoon can be activated for a limited duration.
Use Sacks of Flour to purchase more Moves and powerful boosters for levels in the Fall Event!
Choose a dessert on the board to devour it. Can only be used on desserts! Boosters are global and not bound to a level.
Removes all desserts from a row! Can only be used on desserts! Boosters are global and not bound to a level.
Removes all desserts from a column! Can only be used on desserts! Boosters are global and not bound to a level.
Quantum Shards can be gained from the Quantum Pass. This special resource is used for special actions like skipping production times. Quantum Shards will reset after a Quantum Championship.
Quantum Medals can be obtained as rewards in Quantum Incursions. Use them to buy Quantum Expansions for your City.
Use Quantum Actions to execute actions on the map or produce goods and recruit units in your Quantum Settlement.
Use Teeth to purchase health potions!
Keys can be collected from winning fights against enemies. Use them to open valuable chests!
Keys can be collected from winning fights against enemies. Use them to open valuable chests!

Spend Paper Money to roll the Dice and move around the board!
Roll a Golden Dice to choose the roll outcome and move along the board! Rolls between 1-6.
Spend Avalon Shillings to roll the Dice and move around the board!
Roll a Golden Dice to choose the roll outcome and move along the board! Rolls between 1-6.
Quantum Coins can be gained from the Quantum Settlement and as Node Rewards. They will reset after every Quantum Incursion season.
Quantum Supplies can be gained from the Quantum Settlement and as Node Rewards. They will reset after every Quantum Incursion season.
When activated, the Golden Ticket eliminates the need for Entrance Tickets to play a level. The Golden Ticket can be activated for a limited duration
Fast forward all your productions by 2 hours without spending Pots of Gold. Earn this exclusive reward by completing quests in the Rival Challenges.
Hire your upgraded managers without spending Pots of Gold. Earn this exclusive reward by completing quests in the Rival Challenges.
Get an instant discount on Shamrocks needed to proceed to the next town. Usable once per town, this exclusive reward is earned by completing quests in the Rival Challenges.
Use Battle Tickets to initiate battles in the History Event!
Utilize Battle Coins to buy health, ability cards, and redraws in the History Event!

Enhances the likelihood of acquiring special ability cards in the shop like Assassination, Grand Bounty, League Boost, Grand League, and Reinforcements.

Activate the Super Board by completing the Golden Dragon Statue. While active, enjoy doubled Show Two, Double Payout, and Daily Specials, along with enhanced rewards and accelerated Grand Prize progress.
Unveils all Show Two, Double Payout and Shuffle tiles on the current board. Exclusively available in Rival Challenges.

Doubles the reward of the next tile that is uncovered and after that reveals two hidden rewards on the current board. The uncovered tile will also cost no Doubloons. Exclusively available in Rival Challenges.

Destroys one random tile and its reward on the current board. Key rewards like Show Two, Double Payout, Daily Specials, Calendar Keys, or Golden Dragon parts can't be destroyed. Exclusively available in Rival Challenges.
Workers can be collected from quests and incidents or can be purchased. Use it to spawn new pieces on the board, to reset your board, to reroll tasks or to save your Chest level.
Spawn pieces without spending any Workers with a chance to spawn rainbow pieces.
Break down a higher-level piece into two lower-level pieces. Any keys or key parts on the higher-level piece will be retained on both lower-level pieces.
Converts all pieces of the same family on the board into rainbow pieces. Rainbow pieces can be merged with any other piece.
Fast forward all your productions by 2 hours without spending Gemstones. Earn this exclusive reward by completing quests in the Rival Challenges.
Hire your upgraded Overseers without spending Gemstones. Earn this exclusive reward by completing quests in the Rival Challenges.
Get an instant discount on Feast Provisions needed to proceed to the next Banquet. Usable once per Banquet, this exclusive reward is earned by completing quests in the Rival Challenges.
Dark Matter can be obtained in Exploration Sites on the Continent Map. Dark Matter is required to produce Goods in your Space Hub Colony.
Silver Crystals are a Space Age Space Hub good.
Dark Energy Batteries are a Space Age Space Hub good.
Oxygen Pills are a Space Age Space Hub good.
Deep Space Data is a Space Age Space Hub good.
Hypersleep Modules are a Space Age Space Hub good.
Activate the Super Board by completing the Merry Snowman. While active, enjoy doubled Show Two, and Double Payout, along with enhanced rewards and accelerated Grand Prize progress.
Reveals all houses with Show Two, Double Payout and Shuffle on the current board.

Doubles the reward of the next house you visit. Visiting this house costs no Wooden Bells, and this visit also reveals two hidden rewards on the current board. Use it with Double Payout to quadruple the reward.
Removes one random house and its reward from the current board. You can't remove key rewards like Show Two, Double Payout, Lantern Coins, Starlight Coins, Calendar Keys, or Merry Snowman.
Collect Wooden Bells from quests, houses, incidents or purchase them. Use them to visit houses in the Winter Fair!
Earn Lantern Coins by visiting houses or claim them from Winter Memories. Trade your Lantern Coins at the Lantern Stall for exclusive rewards.
Earn Starlight Coins by visiting houses on the super board or claim them from Winter Memories. Trade your Starlight Coins at the Starlight Lounge for exclusive rewards.
Earn Camelot Coins by visiting villages or claim them from Merlin's Grimoires. Trade your Camelot Coins at the Camelot Market for exclusive rewards.
Earn Pendragon Coins by visiting villages on the Super Board or claim them from Merlin's Grimoires. Trade your Pendragon Coins at the Pendragon Hoard for exclusive rewards.
Use Valor Tokens to upgrade your Historical Allies to a higher Rarity! Allies can unlock new Skills when they Evolve.
Use Heroic Scrolls to Level Up your Historical Allies. Levelling up Allies strengthens their Skills.
Each Scroll grants XP to an ally, with Level 2 granting 2,000 XP.
Each Scroll grants XP to an ally, with Level 3 granting 5,000 XP.
Each Scroll grants XP to an ally, with Level 4 granting 10,000 XP.
Each Scroll grants XP to an ally, with Level 5 granting 100,000 XP.
Earn Fate Amulets by completing quests, resolving incidents, or through purchase! Use them to hurl Axes at the Viking Wheel and win epic rewards.
Collect Opal Seals in the Legacy Exchange.
Earn Eco Tokens by completing Tasks and opening Chests. Spend them in the Eco Store for exclusive rewards.
Earn Hydro Tokens from the World Challenge. Trade your Hydro Tokens at the Hydro Store for exclusive rewards.
Collect Silver Coins as a reward in Guild Battlegrounds. This currency does not expire.
Collect Gold Coins as a reward in Guild Battlegrounds. This currency does not expire.
Collect Platinum Coins as a reward in Guild Battlegrounds. This currency does not expire.

Mason Marks are earned by collecting Jars during the Fall Event. The higher the Jar’s star rating, the better your chances of receiving them. Use Mason Marks at the Baker’s Stall to claim exclusive seasonal rewards
Earn Sacred Seals by completing tasks in each town, with the most Sacred Seals found by opening reward Chests. Trade your Sacred Seals in the Bard’s Bazaar for exclusive rewards.
Chrono Alloys, collected from buildings within the current Settlement, are crucial throughout the whole Quantum Incursion. At the end of each Incursion this resource will reset.
Collect Lunar Coins as a reward in the Quantum Incursions. This currency does not expire.
Collect Solar Coins as a reward in the Quantum Incursions. This currency does not expire.
Collect Stellar Coins as a reward in the Quantum Incursions. This currency does not expire.
Common Jade Coins can be obtained by playing any Guild Expedition Trial. This currency does not expire.
Common Jade Snakes can be obtained by playing higher Guild Expedition Trials. This currency does not expire.
Uncommon Jade Coyotes can be obtained by playing higher Guild Expedition Trials. This currency does not expire.
Uncommon Jade Statues can be obtained by playing higher Guild Expedition Trials. This currency does not expire.

Purchase Forge Friday 2025 Coins and spend them in the Forge Friday 2025 Store for exclusive rewards. Usable only while the Forge Friday 2025 Store is open.
Purchase May Madness 2026 Coins and spend them in the May Madness 2026 Store for exclusive rewards. Usable only while the May Madness 2026 Store is open.
Earn Research Coins by completing Anniversary tasks. Trade your Research Coins at the Research Lab for exclusive rewards.
Earn Network Coins from the World Challenge. Trade your Network Coins at the Network Vault for exclusive rewards.
Earn Muninn Coins by throwing Axes at the Vikings Wheel and completing daily tasks. Use them at the Fjord Market to trade for exclusive rewards.
Geri Coins are found only on the Vikings Wheel. Each Coin grants bonus Grand Prize points and can be exchanged at the Fjord Market for exclusive prizes.
Collect Royal Favor from quests, villages, incidents or purchase them. Use them to visit villages in Camelot's realm!

Activate the Super Board by completing Merlin's Seal. While active, there will be no 'Shuffle', but two 'Show Two', and two 'Double Payout', along with enhanced rewards and accelerated Grand Prize progress.
Collect 5 Dragonsteel Shards to reforge a piece of Excalibur you missed!
Reveals all villages with Show Two, Double Payout and Shuffle on the current board.

Doubles the reward of the next village you visit. Visiting this village costs no Royal Favor, and this visit also reveals two hidden rewards on the current board. Use it with Double Payout to quadruple the reward.
Removes one random village and its reward from the current board. You can't remove key rewards like Show Two, Double Payout, Camelot Coins, Pendragon Coins, Dragonsteel Ingot, or Merlin's Seals.
